g.text: Reactive Programming Process: reactive() vs observe()
• Returns values • Lazy evaluation • Cached • Pure function
• No return value • Immediate Execution • External effects • DB/File/Log
Example: input$slider change → reactive() recalculation → observe() external storage → render*() screen output
Reactive Programming Integration Platform: Quarto Reactive Ecosystem
Reactive Engine ↓ Quarto Integration (Real-time Data Flow)
⚡ Reactive Paradigm: Quarto = Integration Hub for All Reactive Technologies
✅ R/Python Shiny Full Integration | ⚠️ Julia/OJS Partial Integration = Hybrid Reactive Ecosystem
